notes: Card: ' L' x3, 'Q' x2, '-L' x2, ' Chinese' x2, '-B', '.O', '.J', in biomedical citations, 72% echo regime. Probes: 'Q' in Gu YQ 0.954, '-B' 0.720, ' M' in Li, M.O. 0.240, '-L' 0.213; 'Smith JR' 0.033, 'Anna Lee and John Green' 0.029. Near misses are Western names in the same citation frames.
